title: Shopify product row
description: One product from a Shopify storefront, read from the store's own public endpoints.

status.title: Status
status.description: DELIVERED, NO_PRICE, NOT_CHECKED_BLOCKED, NOT_CHECKED_PRIVATE_TARGET, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR or INVALID_INPUT.

store.title: Store
store.description: Store host as given in the input.

price.title: Price
price.description: Lowest variant price in the store currency. null when the store publishes no price.

priceMax.title: Price, highest variant
priceMax.description: Highest variant price in the store currency.

compareAtPrice.title: Compare at price
compareAtPrice.description: Lowest compare-at price the store publishes, the crossed out price.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Store currency from /meta.json, or from the product page JSON-LD. null when the store did not say.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: in_stock when at least one variant is available, out_of_stock when none is.

variantCount.title: Variants
variantCount.description: How many variants the product has.

variants.title: Variant list
variants.description: sku, title, price, compareAtPrice, available per variant. Empty when includeVariants is off.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: updated_at from the store when it publishes one, ISO 8601.

source.title: Source
source.description: json for /products.json, product-json for /products/<handle>.json, page for a product page JSON-LD.

change.title: Change
change.description: new, price-down, price-up, out-of-stock or back-in-stock. null when onlyChanges is off.

previousPrice.title: Previous price
previousPrice.description: Price in the stored snapshot when this row reports a price change.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why this row is not a delivered product.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many products the reason covers, for rows that summarise failures.

httpStatus.title: HTTP status
httpStatus.description: The status the store answered with when the row reports a refusal.
